summary: A wheeled anti-air gun that tracks low drones and high-flying jets with quick-firing flak. It is short-ranged, cannot shoot at the ground, and is outranged by the Su-34's glide bombs, so it guards a point from close by or moves with a column.

sections.title: Anti-aircraft cannon
sections.how: Select the Gepard and left-click an enemy aircraft, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: Its cannon fires quick bursts of flak that track both low drones and high-flying jets. It never fires at ground units or buildings, so it cannot defend itself against tanks or infantry. Its reach is short: keep it close to what it guards, and expect a Su-34 to release its glide bombs from outside the Gepard's range.

sections.title: Move with the column
sections.how: Select the Gepard and left-click the ground where it should go; on touch, tap.
sections.body: It is a wheeled vehicle, so it can follow an armoured push or shift to cover another building. Its armour is light: keep it behind the tanks and pull it back when enemy infantry or anti-tank teams get close.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged Gepard and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The Gepard drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back. Production carries on while it waits its turn.

strong: Guarding a building from close range
weak: A Su-34 bombing from beyond its range
tips: Place it beside what Russia bombs: it engages only targets that come inside its short range.
It cannot shoot ground targets, so pair it with tanks or infantry that can protect it.
Do not chase a Su-34 with it: the jet can bomb from outside the cannon's reach. Use a Patriot for that.
Keep it behind the front: its light armour does not survive a tank or an anti-tank team.
Pull a damaged Gepard back to the vehicle factory; repairs cost half the price.
